description: Mission-author live-verify (bramble d08, duet, shoulder shelf) -- SOLO FALLBACK TIMER path. Run with --pads=1 (SOLO mode: Otto becomes buddy AI). Otto is repeatedly re-teleported to a fixed holding anchor (28.3, 0.5, 12.5) -- flat meadow ground, OUTSIDE the shoulder mound's own footprint, ~13m true-3D from d08 and within buddy_ai's own horizontal-only lag_warp_distance (12m) of Pip so no dramatic bubble-warp ever fires -- every 30 frames for the whole window. This isolates the SINGLE-PLAYER FALLBACK TIMER path specifically (mission_driver.gd DUET_DEFAULT_FALLBACK_SECONDS=10.0s) from the ALSO-true fact that buddy AI's tight follow_distance (2.5m, tighter than duet_radius 3.0m) would otherwise likely satisfy dual_proximity for free within a couple seconds in real solo play (see docs/verify/aliveness-v2-VERIFY.md's own honest note on this) -- a deliberate test-isolation technique using the documented teleport dev-instrument at higher frequency, not a claim that dual-proximity never happens in real solo play. Pip teleports to d08 once at frame 30 and never moves again (single within-radius player, continuous). Expected receipts: no mission_bloomed for ~600 physics frames (10s) after Pip's teleport, then EVT mission_bloomed (archetype=duet, trigger=fallback_timer) once the timer crosses 10.0s, MOON_SAID bramble_d08_duet, then EVT dreamling_collected + mission_caught for d08.
